evidence_snippets: Use cases AI Hypercomputer was designed to meet the needs of the following use cases: Use case Example workloads Large-scale AI and ML workloads Generative AI distributed training Generative AI inference Fraud detection Recommendation models High performance computing (HPC) Complex simulations Drug discovery, protein folding, and genomic analysis Risk analysis and quantitative trading What's next?

Get up and running quickly : AI Hypercomputer provides tools, such as Cluster Director and blueprints , that let you reliably and repeatedly deploy large numbers of accelerator-optimized resources that are configured to support your most demanding AI and ML workloads.

System architecture AI Hypercomputer is comprised of the following layers: Performance-optimized infrastructure : contains accelerators, networking, and storage resources that provide the computing capabilities to support your workloads.
